title: Duality and sign restriction
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $f$ be a function from the $n$-dimensional sign cube to $\\{\pm1\}$, and let $\rho$ assign to each coordinate one of three states: free, fixed to $1$, or fixed to $-1$. Restricting the Boolean dual of $f$ using $\rho$ gives the Boolean dual of $f$ restricted using the coordinatewise negation of $\rho$.
hypotheses_covered: A Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
A coordinate restriction on all $n$ coordinates
